what_to_maintain: Page type structure and format rules
Brand placement rules by page type
what_to_adapt: Product/service terminology (รองเท้าฟุตบอล → client's product category)
Brand names (Nike, Adidas → actual brands from client's industry)
Technical terms (FG, AG, SG → industry-specific technical terms)
Features/benefits (กระชับเท้า, ควบคุมลูกแม่น → product-specific benefits)
CTAs (ไซต์ครบ, พร้อมส่ง → industry-appropriate CTAs like บริการด่วน, ปรึกษาฟรี)
Value propositions (ของแท้ 100% → industry-relevant USPs like มาตรฐานสากล, รับประกันผล)

psychological_frameworks.framework_priority: Use both core frameworks: promise_benefit (value proposition + USP) + use_numbers (categories, years in business, quantity).
psychological_frameworks.application: Brand name FIRST (required), then main benefit, specific numbers (categories, years, quantity), end with specific USP.
psychological_frameworks.example_application: {{BRAND_NAME}} (brand required) + รองเท้าฟุตบอลของแท้ 100% (promise_benefit: authenticity) + ทุกแบรนด์ดัง Nike Adidas Puma (specific brand names showing variety) + จัดส่งฟรีทั่วไทย (promise_benefit: free shipping)

brand_terminology.product_brand: Nike, Adidas, Puma, etc. = brands of products you sell
brand_terminology.rule: These are DIFFERENT brands - don't confuse them!

brand_name_placement.homepage: REQUIRED - {{BRAND_NAME}} must be FIRST element in title, NEVER in H1
brand_name_placement.trust_credibility_pages: REQUIRED - {{BRAND_NAME}} in title after dash, NEVER in H1
brand_name_placement.local_seo_pages: NEVER {{BRAND_NAME}}: user searches 'service + location', not a brand (exception: store_location_pages CAN have brand)
brand_name_placement.product_pages: NEVER {{BRAND_NAME}} - product brand (Nike/Adidas) only if part of product name

collection_pages.brand_collections: Product brand in title (Nike Max Voltage), NEVER {{BRAND_NAME}}
collection_pages.curated_collections: NO brand at all in title (/bestsellers, /new-arrivals, /sale)

brand_name_placement.informational_pages: NEVER {{BRAND_NAME}} - must appear objective for SEO
brand_name_placement.h1_rule_all_pages: NEVER include {{BRAND_NAME}} or any brand suffix in H1 tags (exception: store_location_pages can have brand in H1)

collection_name_format.correct_order: Product brand FIRST, then collection name
collection_name_format.rule: Brand name ALWAYS comes first in collection names

cta_variety.rule: NEVER use same CTA twice in same batch optimization
cta_variety.exception: OK to repeat if optimizing single page in isolation

decision_tree.default: When in doubt: Is user searching for YOUR brand specifically? YES = add brand, NO = don't add

brand_name_and_separator_policy.rule: Brand or site name appears ONLY in the homepage title as the first element. NEVER add the brand name or a '|' separator to non-homepage titles. NEVER use em dash or '|' in any generated output.
brand_name_and_separator_policy.reason: Google shows the Sitename in the SERP, so brand in non-homepage titles wastes character budget needed for keywords and context.
